notes.title: Release Date Postponed
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Thank you so much to the people that have wishlisted the game so far and are looking forward to playing BOK-BOK. The release date has been postponed from the 11th of March to the 13th of March. Fret not, the game is finished and ready to launch. Unfortunately due to Steam's restriction we can only launch on the 13th earliest.
